windows.title: Save the photos from a post
windows.text: Instagram, Pinterest, Reddit, X and more: one photo or a whole carousel. Click a photo to leave it out.

android.title: Save the photos from a post
android.text: Instagram, Pinterest, Reddit, X and more: one photo or a whole carousel. Tap a photo to leave it out.

windows.title: Sign-in happens by itself
windows.text: Downloads go signed out. When a site asks for a sign-in, Keepfin uses one it finds (Firefox, or Keepfin's own) and tries again.

android.title: Sign-in happens by itself
android.text: Downloads go signed out. When a site asks for a sign-in, Keepfin uses yours and tries again.

windows.title: Mixes and new releases on Home
windows.text: Mixes made from your own plays, on this PC. Follow an artist and Home tells you when something new is out.

android.title: Mixes and new releases on Home
android.text: Mixes made from your own plays, on this phone. Follow an artist and Home tells you when something new is out.

windows.title: Make Keepfin yours
windows.text: Dock or float the sidebar and drag its width. Edit Home and Library: show, hide and move sections, rows or grids, and the card size.

android.title: Arrange Home and Library
android.text: Show, hide and move sections, pick a row or a grid, and set the card size.

windows.title: Faster, safer copies
windows.text: Google Drive needs half the requests, Dropbox syncs again, and a renamed file moves instead of copying twice.

android.title: Faster, safer copies
android.text: Google Drive needs half the requests, Dropbox syncs again, and a renamed file moves instead of copying twice.
